hero.title: HEY
hero.quote: I've been building products for 8 years. What drives me now is helping people, and society more broadly, restructure around what AI can bring us. I don't think we'll get there by doing the same things faster. AI gives us a chance to start again from a blank page, in our work as in our daily lives, and I want us to take it together.

about.intro: I think AI won't just <highlight>speed up what we already do</highlight>. It will force us to <highlight>rethink how society is organized</highlight>.
about.detail: Most companies use it to save a bit of time on what they were already doing. I get it, it's the reassuring path. But it misses the point: this is a real upheaval, and it touches our work as much as our daily lives. AI lets us rebuild our organizations starting from people, not from tools. Done right, it can change our relationship with work, and more broadly the way we live together. If companies make more money along the way, good, but that's not what gets me up in the morning. What I want is to do my part for a better world.

craft.title: AI POWERED
craft.description: AI made me stack-agnostic. Language, framework or platform: I pick what fits the problem, not what I already knew.
